title: Chapter 20 Revision — A2 Complete Review
description: Comprehensive A2 review quiz covering aspect, tenses, cases, formal register, and key vocabulary from all of A2 (Chapters 11–20).

questions.prompt: Codziennie ___ gazetę rano. (Every day I read the newspaper in the morning.) [habit → aspect]
questions.explanation: Habit (codziennie) → imperfective past: 'czytałem'. 'Przeczytałem' = perfective (I read through / finished reading — one-time). 'Czytam' = present habit. 'Przeczytam' = perf future.

questions.prompt: W końcu ___ ten projekt! (I finally finished this project!)
questions.explanation: 'W końcu' (finally) signals completed result → perfective: 'skończyłem'. 'Kończyłem' = imperfective past (was finishing — process). The perfective captures the achievement.

questions.prompt: Wczoraj moje siostry ___ do Krakowa. (Yesterday my sisters went to Kraków.) [non-virile plural past]
questions.explanation: Non-virile plural (siostry = sisters, all female) → -ły ending: 'pojechały'. Virile plural (men/mixed group) → -li: 'pojechali'. 'Pojechała' = singular feminine.

questions.prompt: Jutro ___ ten raport. (Tomorrow she will finish this report.) [perfective future, 3rd sg fem]
questions.explanation: 'Skończy' = perfective future 3rd sg (she will finish/complete). 'Będzie kończyć' = imperfective future (will be in process of finishing). 'Jutro' + completed result → perfective.

questions.prompt: Nie ma ___ w lodówce. (There's no milk in the fridge.) [genitive after negation]
questions.explanation: After negation 'nie ma' → genitive: mleko (n) → mleka. 'Nie ma mleka' = There's no milk. Contrast: 'Jest mleko' (nominative) = There is milk.

questions.prompt: Jadę ___ pracy ___ autobusem. (I go to work by bus.)
questions.explanation: 'Do pracy' = to work (do + genitive). 'Autobusem' = by bus (instrumental, no preposition needed — means of transport). So: 'Jadę do pracy autobusem.' — no preposition before autobusem.

questions.prompt: Kiedy ___ do sklepu, spotkałam koleżankę. (When I was walking to the shop, I met a friend.) [aspect in kiedy clause]
questions.explanation: Kiedy + ongoing background → imperfective: 'szłam' (was walking, imperf). 'Poszłam' = perfective (went = completed trip). The friend encounter happens during the walking, so walking is the ongoing background.

questions.prompt: Formal question to a man: Jak ___ ma na imię? (What is your first name?)
questions.explanation: Formal address to a man: 'Pan' + 3rd person singular. 'Jak Pan ma na imię?' = What is your first name? (formal). Informal: 'Jak masz na imię?' (ty form). 'Pani' = for a woman.

questions.prompt: Uczę się polskiego, ___ zdać egzamin PKE. (I study Polish in order to pass the PKE exam.) [purpose]
questions.explanation: 'Żeby + infinitive' = in order to (purpose, same subject). 'Uczę się, żeby zdać egzamin.' 'Bo' = because (reason). 'Że' = that (introduces statement). 'Ale' = but.

options: I managed to / I succeeded in
questions.explanation: 'Udać się' (perf, impersonal) = to succeed. 'Udało mi się zdać' = I managed to pass. The dative pronoun (mi) = the person who succeeds. 'Nie udało mi się' = I didn't manage to / I failed.

questions.prompt: What does 'coraz' mean in 'Mój polski jest coraz lepszy'?
questions.explanation: 'Coraz + comparative' = more and more / increasingly. 'Coraz lepszy' = getting better and better. 'Coraz trudniej' = increasingly difficult. Very common pattern in Polish for gradual change.

questions.prompt: PKE error correction: 'Jestem lekarz.' — What is wrong?
options: Should be: Jestem lekarzem (instrumental after być)
questions.explanation: After 'być' with profession → instrumental: lekarz → lekarzem. 'Jestem lekarzem' = I am a doctor. Using nominative (Jestem lekarz) is a very common error at A2 level and is specifically tested in PKE.
